no_overwrite_rule: Derived, normalized, translated, converted, rounded, inferred, or calculated values must be additional fields and must never replace raw_value.

provenance_rules.file_backed: source_sha256_if_file_backed required when source is a local file
provenance_rules.web_backed: source_location must identify the exact URL/page/section or exact retrieval identity
provenance_rules.versioned: source_version/build/date must be retained where available
